title: 语法 · 冠词与数量｜可数性和范围 · 60 句
description: a/an/the/零冠词、可数与不可数、计量单位、few/little、整体与部分。

items.zh: 我需要一个能读懂这张处方的药剂师。
items.en: I need a pharmacist who can read this prescription.
answers: I need a pharmacist who can read this prescription.
items.notes: a 表某一位尚未特指的人；pharmacist 是可数单数。

items.zh: 她给了我一个关于午餐的新建议。
items.en: She gave me a new suggestion for lunch.
answers: She gave me a new suggestion for lunch.
items.notes: suggestion 可数；advice 不可数，不能写 an advice。

items.zh: 这是一所规模很小的大学，却有出色的植物园。
items.en: It is a small university with an excellent botanical garden.
answers: It is a small university with an excellent botanical garden.
items.notes: university 首音为辅音 /j/，用 a；excellent 首音元音，用 an。

items.zh: 我等了整整一个小时才找到空桌。
items.en: I waited a whole hour before finding a free table.
answers: I waited a whole hour before finding a free table.
items.notes: whole 首音辅音用 a；hour 单独前用 an hour。

items.zh: 她想成为一名口译员，而不是笔译员。
items.en: She wants to be an interpreter rather than a translator.
answers: She wants to be an interpreter rather than a translator.
items.notes: 职业可数单数前用冠词，按发音选 an 或 a。

items.zh: 我在书页间发现了一张一英镑的纸币。
items.en: I found a one-pound note between the pages.
answers: I found a one-pound note between the pages.
items.notes: one 首音 /w/，因此用 a，不是 an。

items.zh: 这条路上有一家通宵营业的咖啡馆。
items.en: There is an all-night cafe on this road.
answers: There is an all-night cafe on this road.
items.notes: all-night 首音元音，冠词用 an。

items.zh: 他把一次失误当成了学习的机会。
items.en: He treated a mistake as an opportunity to learn.
answers: He treated a mistake as an opportunity to learn.
items.notes: 首次提及的 mistake 和 opportunity 均用不定冠词。

items.zh: 我们想找个安静的地方谈一谈。
items.en: We want a quiet place for a conversation.
answers: We want a quiet place for a conversation.
items.notes: a quiet place 不指特定地点；conversation 此处可数。

items.zh: 那件事对我来说是一次意外的考验。
items.en: The incident was an unexpected test for me.
answers: The incident was an unexpected test for me.
items.notes: unexpected 元音开头；test 为一次具体考验。

items.zh: 我买了一顶帽子，帽檐有点太宽。
items.en: I bought a hat; the brim is a little too wide.
answers: I bought a hat; the brim is a little too wide.
items.notes: 首次 a hat，所属且唯一可识别部分用 the brim。

items.zh: 请把你刚才用过的杯子放进水槽。
items.en: Put the cup you just used in the sink.
answers: Put the cup you just used in the sink.
items.notes: 定语明确是哪只杯子，因此用 the。

items.zh: 弹钢琴的人坐在窗口旁。
items.en: The person playing the piano is seated by the window.
answers: The person playing the piano is seated by the window.
items.notes: the person 被修饰语限定；play the piano 为常见乐器用法。

items.zh: 我们沿着河岸走到最近的桥。
items.en: We followed the river to the nearest bridge.
answers: We followed the river to the nearest bridge.
items.notes: 最高级 nearest 前通常用 the。

items.zh: 这道菜最难的部分是掌握火候。
items.en: The hardest part of the dish is controlling the heat.
answers: The hardest part of the dish is controlling the heat.
items.notes: 最高级 hardest 与可识别部分用 the。

items.zh: 月亮今晚从云后露了出来。
items.en: The moon appeared from behind the clouds tonight.
answers: The moon appeared from behind the clouds tonight.
items.notes: moon 为语境中唯一的天体，用 the。

items.zh: 我更喜欢两种酱料中较温和的那种。
items.en: I prefer the milder of the two sauces.
answers: I prefer the milder of the two sauces.
items.notes: the + 比较级 + of the two 指两者中特定一个。

items.zh: 这就是我们昨晚讨论的那个问题。
items.en: This is the issue we discussed last night.
answers: This is the issue we discussed last night.
items.notes: 后置从句使 issue 明确，用 the。

items.zh: 这家店的门直到九点才打开。
items.en: The door of the shop stays closed until nine.
answers: The door of the shop stays closed until nine.
items.notes: of 短语明确所属门，用 the。

items.zh: 请从列表的末尾开始核对。
items.en: Please start checking from the end of the list.
answers: Please start checking from the end of the list.
items.notes: the end of 表特定列表的末端。

items.zh: 耐心并不意味着什么都不做。
items.en: Patience does not mean doing nothing.
answers: Patience does not mean doing nothing.
Patience doesn't mean doing nothing.
items.notes: 抽象名词 patience 泛指时不用 a 或 the。

items.zh: 孩子需要机会自己作决定。
items.en: Children need opportunities to make decisions themselves.
answers: Children need opportunities to make decisions themselves.
items.notes: 复数 children 泛指儿童，不加定冠词。

items.zh: 我们晚饭后常谈论音乐。
items.en: We often discuss music after dinner.
answers: We often discuss music after dinner.
items.notes: music 不可数泛指；惯常餐名 dinner 前不加冠词。

items.zh: 她在大学里学习化学。
items.en: She studies chemistry at university.
answers: She studies chemistry at university.
items.notes: 学科名 chemistry 零冠词；at university 表学生身份活动。

items.zh: 足球需要配合，不只是速度。
items.en: Football requires coordination, not just speed.
answers: Football requires coordination, not just speed.
items.notes: 运动名 football 泛指不加 the。

items.zh: 周日我们通常步行去购物。
items.en: We usually go shopping on Sundays.
answers: We usually go shopping on Sundays.
items.notes: go shopping 不加冠词；复数 Sundays 表惯常星期日。

items.zh: 牛奶对这份配方不是必需的。
items.en: Milk is not essential to this recipe.
answers: Milk is not essential to this recipe.
Milk isn't essential to this recipe.
items.notes: milk 作为物质泛指不用冠词；this 已限定 recipe。

items.zh: 山里的生活与城市生活不同。
items.en: Life in the mountains differs from city life.
answers: Life in the mountains differs from city life.
items.notes: life 泛指生活；the mountains 为通常地域表达。

items.zh: 我们坐火车旅行，却乘出租车回家。
items.en: We travelled by train but came home by taxi.
answers: We travelled by train but came home by taxi.
items.notes: by + 交通方式前不加冠词。

items.zh: 早餐可以改善注意力，但并非每个人早上都有胃口。
items.en: Breakfast can improve concentration, though not everyone feels hungry in the morning.
answers: Breakfast can improve concentration, though not everyone feels hungry in the morning.
items.notes: breakfast 泛指餐食；in the morning 为固定表达。

items.zh: 我只需要两条简短的建议。
items.en: I need only two brief pieces of advice.
answers: I need only two brief pieces of advice.
items.notes: advice 不可数，用 pieces of 计数。

items.zh: 这个瓶子里还剩一点蜂蜜。
items.en: There is a little honey left in the jar.
answers: There is a little honey left in the jar.
items.notes: honey 不可数，用 a little，而非 a few。

items.zh: 这些家具中有几件需要修理。
items.en: Several pieces of this furniture need repair.
answers: Several pieces of this furniture need repair.
items.notes: furniture 不可数；pieces 为可数主语中心。

items.zh: 每人可以领取三份面包。
items.en: Each person may take three portions of bread.
answers: Each person may take three portions of bread.
items.notes: bread 不直接加复数，用 portions of 表份数。

items.zh: 我们缺少有关路况的信息。
items.en: We lack information about road conditions.
answers: We lack information about road conditions.
items.notes: information 不可数；不能用 informations。

items.zh: 我能喝一杯水而不是一瓶水吗？
items.en: Could I have a glass of water rather than a bottle?
answers: Could I have a glass of water rather than a bottle?
items.notes: glass 与 bottle 为容器量词；water 保持不可数。

items.zh: 这趟旅程给了她宝贵的经验。
items.en: The journey gave her valuable experience.
answers: The journey gave her valuable experience.
items.notes: experience 泛指经验不可数；一次经历则可用 an experience。

items.zh: 晚餐包括两种奶酪。
items.en: Dinner includes two kinds of cheese.
answers: Dinner includes two kinds of cheese.
items.notes: cheese 作物质，kinds 提供种类计数。

items.zh: 表演者需要更多设备，却不需要更多房间。
items.en: The performers need more equipment but no extra rooms.
answers: The performers need more equipment but no extra rooms.
items.notes: equipment 不可数；room 表房间可数。

items.zh: 请在汤里加一小撮盐。
items.en: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
answers: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
items.notes: a pinch of：一小撮；salt 不可数。

items.zh: 几乎没有游客注意到墙上的旧照片。
items.en: Few visitors noticed the old photographs on the wall.
answers: Few visitors noticed the old photographs on the wall.
items.notes: few + 可数复数表示几乎没有，带否定意味。

items.zh: 我们还有几分钟，可以再听一首。
items.en: We have a few minutes left for another song.
answers: We have a few minutes left for another song.
items.notes: a few 表还有一些，与 few 的不足意味不同。

items.zh: 剩下的时间很少，不能再走错路。
items.en: Little time remains for another wrong turn.
answers: Little time remains for another wrong turn.
items.notes: little + 不可数名词表几乎没有。

items.zh: 这道汤有一点甜味，但并不腻。
items.en: The soup has a little sweetness without being cloying.
answers: The soup has a little sweetness without being cloying.
items.notes: a little + 不可数名词表示少量存在。

items.zh: 我们带的食物太多，饮用水却不够。
items.en: We brought too much food but not enough drinking water.
answers: We brought too much food but not enough drinking water.
items.notes: food 与 water 均不可数，用 much 与 enough。

items.zh: 愿意当导游的人很多，但熟悉这条路线的人很少。
items.en: Many people want to guide, but few know this route.
answers: Many people want to guide, but few know this route.
items.notes: many、few 指可数的人，不用 much、little。

items.zh: 我没有多余的现金，但可以借给你一张通行证。
items.en: I have no spare cash, but I can lend you a pass.
answers: I have no spare cash, but I can lend you a pass.
items.notes: cash 不可数；pass 可数单数用 a。

items.zh: 两人都没提出可行的替代办法。
items.en: Neither person offered a workable alternative.
answers: Neither person offered a workable alternative.
items.notes: neither + 单数名词；限定恰好两者。

items.zh: 任何一条小路都能通往车站。
items.en: Either path leads to the station.
answers: Either path leads to the station.
items.notes: either 指两者中任一，后用单数 path 和 leads。

items.zh: 我们并不需要每位客人都带礼物。
items.en: We do not need every guest to bring a gift.
answers: We do not need every guest to bring a gift.
We don't need every guest to bring a gift.
items.notes: every + 单数；not ... every 为部分否定。

items.zh: 所有蛋糕都已分好，其中一部分留给了晚到的人。
items.en: All the cakes are sliced, and some are reserved for late arrivals.
answers: All the cakes are sliced, and some are reserved for late arrivals.
items.notes: all the 指特定一批；some 替代其中一部分。

items.zh: 大多数当地家庭都认识这位面包师。
items.en: Most local families know the baker.
answers: Most local families know the baker.
items.notes: most 直接接泛指复数；不用 most of families。

items.zh: 大多数到场者都愿意再来一次。
items.en: Most of those present would return.
answers: Most of those present would return.
items.notes: most of 后接已限定群体 those present。

items.zh: 我喝了半杯果汁，把剩下的留给了你。
items.en: I drank half a glass of juice and left the rest for you.
answers: I drank half a glass of juice and left the rest for you.
items.notes: half a + 单数单位；the rest 指余下部分。

items.zh: 每桌都放了同样数量的茶杯。
items.en: The same number of cups was placed on each table.
answers: The same number of cups was placed on each table.
items.notes: number 作单数主语；each table 单数。

items.zh: 除了两份菜单，其余的都印有价格。
items.en: All but two menus include prices.
answers: All but two menus include prices.
items.notes: all but two 表除两份之外全都。

items.zh: 两家餐馆都没有室外座位。
items.en: Neither of the restaurants has outdoor seating.
answers: Neither of the restaurants has outdoor seating.
items.notes: neither of + 复数限定群体，规范书面语谓语常用单数。

items.zh: 整座村庄都参加了庆典。
items.en: The whole village took part in the celebration.
answers: The whole village took part in the celebration.
items.notes: the whole + 单数整体；与 all the villagers 区分。

items.zh: 我们需要再加一张椅子，而不是再加一整张桌子。
items.en: We need one more chair, not another whole table.
answers: We need one more chair, not another whole table.
items.notes: one more + 单数；another 表另一个。

items.zh: 每位客人都得到了一杯茶，但不是每杯都有牛奶。
items.en: Each guest received tea, but not every cup contained milk.
answers: Each guest received tea, but not every cup contained milk.
items.notes: each 强调逐个分配；not every 限定第二分句范围。
